0022600158.text: The Cleveland Cavaliers (4-2, 3-0 at home, on a one-game win streak) host the Oklahoma City Thunder (4-2, on a two-game losing streak) in the Cavaliers' seventh game of the 2026-27 season, with Cleveland sitting 2nd in the Central and Oklahoma City 2nd in the Northwest. The teams have not met yet this season, and Cleveland lost both games to Oklahoma City in the 2025-26 season, most recently 121-113 in Oklahoma City on February 22, 2026. Cleveland guard Jaylon Tyson is day-to-day with an ankle sprain and is a game-time decision, while Oklahoma City is without Alex Caruso (ankle), Cason Wallace (shoulder surgery), Chet Holmgren (knee), Jalen Williams (leg fracture), Nikola Topic (back), and Thomas Sorber (knee).
